automated_evidence.rule: Store only short candidate values and page pointers; do not commit full text excerpts.

supplement_extraction.rule: Supplement text extraction writes only ignored local text artifacts; tracked audit files store counts, statuses, and short evidence pointers.

manual_reviews.rule: Manual reviews promote auto-mined candidates only after repeated critical passes; store normalized values, field statuses, confidence scores, and short source pointers, not full text.

segment_1_stimulus_reconstruction.label: Stimulus type
segment_1_stimulus_reconstruction.description: Noise, tone, ecological sound, speech, or custom/baked stimulus class.

segment_1_stimulus_reconstruction.label: Source/provenance
segment_1_stimulus_reconstruction.description: Original asset, generated stimulus, licensed set, apparatus source, or supplement file.

segment_1_stimulus_reconstruction.label: Number of trajectories/tones
segment_1_stimulus_reconstruction.description: Distinct looming/receding/static paths, tones, or auditory conditions.

segment_1_stimulus_reconstruction.label: Trajectory path
segment_1_stimulus_reconstruction.description: Start/end distance, direction, body anchor, azimuth/elevation, and spatial coordinate frame.

segment_1_stimulus_reconstruction.label: Duration
segment_1_stimulus_reconstruction.description: Auditory stimulus duration and any pre/post padding.

segment_1_stimulus_reconstruction.label: Speed/path length
segment_1_stimulus_reconstruction.description: Motion speed, path length, propagation timing, or distance-at-time mapping.

segment_1_stimulus_reconstruction.label: Auditory conditions
segment_1_stimulus_reconstruction.description: Valence, direction, semantic, movement, or apparatus conditions affecting the auditory stimulus.

segment_1_stimulus_reconstruction.label: Gain/envelope
segment_1_stimulus_reconstruction.description: SPL, intensity law, gain curve, cross-fade, or amplitude-field information.

segment_1_stimulus_reconstruction.label: Renderer/HRTF/speaker apparatus
segment_1_stimulus_reconstruction.description: Headphones, HRTF, Unity/3D Tune-In, physical speakers, arrays, or other rendering provenance.

segment_2_sequence_and_intermixing.label: Trial rows/families
segment_2_sequence_and_intermixing.description: Within-trial audio sequence families and task rows.

segment_2_sequence_and_intermixing.label: Condition intermixing
segment_2_sequence_and_intermixing.description: Whether systematic manipulations are intermixed with task trials or separated.

segment_2_sequence_and_intermixing.label: Blocked/random order
segment_2_sequence_and_intermixing.description: Blocked condition structure, random intermixing, and task-critical order constraints.

segment_2_sequence_and_intermixing.label: ITI/jitter policy
segment_2_sequence_and_intermixing.description: Fixed ITI, jitter values, jitter range, distribution, or hazard-control policy.

segment_2_sequence_and_intermixing.label: Response window
segment_2_sequence_and_intermixing.description: Allowed response interval, timeout, or scoring window.

segment_2_sequence_and_intermixing.label: Task-critical sequence rules
segment_2_sequence_and_intermixing.description: Special trial scheduling, target/no-target logic, or expectancy controls.

segment_3_tactile_soa_baseline.label: Tactile stimulus
segment_3_tactile_soa_baseline.description: Tactile modality, body site, waveform, duration, frequency, amplitude, and calibration.

segment_3_tactile_soa_baseline.label: SOA/distance-at-touch table
segment_3_tactile_soa_baseline.description: SOA values, tactile timing values, or distance-at-tactile values.

segment_3_tactile_soa_baseline.label: Baseline strategy
segment_3_tactile_soa_baseline.description: Tactile-only, far/static, fastest-baseline, SOA-matched, direction-coupled, or other baseline type.

segment_3_tactile_soa_baseline.label: Baseline SOAs/timing
segment_3_tactile_soa_baseline.description: Baseline SOA values, baseline timing relative to omitted sound, or fixed baseline schedule.

segment_3_tactile_soa_baseline.label: Catch-trial type
segment_3_tactile_soa_baseline.description: Auditory-only, tactile-only, omitted target, no-go, target-absent, or other catch rule.

segment_4_counts.label: Repetitions per tactile SOA/condition
segment_4_counts.description: Trial repetitions for each tactile SOA crossed with relevant conditions.

segment_4_counts.label: Block count
segment_4_counts.description: Number of blocks, sessions, or phases when task-relevant.

segment_4_counts.label: Total trial count
segment_4_counts.description: Total trials per participant, block, condition, or experiment.

review_rule.missing_value_rule: Only mark not_reported_after_review after main PDF extraction, targeted methods/table search, supplement search, and fallback extractor/source check have all been attempted.
review_rule.copyright_boundary: Do not commit PDFs, supplements, extracted full text, screenshots of pages, or long verbatim passages.
review_rule.automated_evidence_rule: Automated evidence mining stores only short candidate values and page pointers; it is not a substitute for final human/AI critical review against PDFs and supplements.
